note: Missing `image` — removing the logo is an explicit `null`, never an omitted member.
Unknown top-level member — the logo is the only thing this task sets; a URL goes through vtc/community/profile/update.
SVG is not a logo media type — it is a document that can carry script and fetch resources, so a client rasterizes it before sending.
AVIF is a directory image type, not a logo one — the logo enum is its own, not ImageMediaType.
Padded or standard base64 — `data` is base64url without padding (RFC 4648 §5).
Unknown member inside `image` — dimensions are the community's to choose when it re-encodes, never the sender's.
Empty `data` — an image has at least one byte; removal is `image: null`.
Response with no `stored` — a caller must be able to tell a no-op from a change.
A stored logo larger than the 512-pixel bound — the community caps the longer side when it re-encodes.
